applet.name: SpotifyConnect
applet.title: Spotify Connect
applet.desc: Standalone Spotify Connect playback for Logitech Squeezebox Radio. LMS is only needed to install the applet.
applet.changes: Latch audio-completed events for reliable automatic track advancement; preserve complete endings and immediate manual skips; fix mobile selection and native Now Playing updates; remove UI shell polling.
